title: Apply drops unread prefix when option replacement skips span start
description:
## Intent

After PR #11, mid-word spans are dropped. A live wiki-janitor rescan (`--require-judge`) then `options` + `apply` to a **working copy** still produced broken prose:

`the way water finds the lower It ended the way it started`

The judge span started at `gap in a wall.` (word-bounded, not mid-word). The chosen option replacement began at `It ended…` and **omitted the span prefix** `gap in a wall.

`. Apply deleted that prefix. Published `wiki-janitor.md` was not written (hash `60f0d280…` unchanged).

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Apply preserves unread span prefix
  Scenario: Replacement that does not echo the start of the span is rejected
    Given a finding span that includes the end of the previous sentence
    And a rewrite option whose replacement starts later in that span
    When limatus apply runs on a working copy
    Then apply fails closed
    And the working copy is unchanged
```

## Out of scope

Published-file apply. Asking a human to pick option ids.

comments.author: 8458c498-f041-7092-e4e3-6418236765a7
comments.text:
Grok plan. Composer implements. Worktree `/tmp/limatus-LIM-073443-span-prefix` branch `cursor/feature/LIM-073443-span-prefix` off origin/main.

Fail closed in `apply_patch` (and drop at option map time): if a non-empty replacement matches a later substring of the span excerpt (`excerpt.find(replacement[:40]) > 0`), the prefix would be deleted. Raise before any working-copy write. Deletions (`replacement == ""`) unchanged. No `project/` in the PR. Unittest + CLI apply unchanged working copy.
